name: data-cleaning-for-excel
title_zh: 粘进表格的脏数据，先洗成能直接透视的一片区域
tagline_zh: 从系统导出的表总带着空行、重复行、日期格式乱跳、数字混着文本，手动清到第三行就想关掉。它按你表里已有的格式当基准。
tagline_en: Exports arrive with blank rows, duplicates, dates in three formats and numbers stored as text. It aligns the.
desc_en: Turns pasted or exported data with mixed formats, blank rows, or duplicates into a clean, consistently formatted range ready for analysis. Use it right after pasting raw data into a worksheet.
why_zh: 它不猜你想要什么格式，而是先读你表里已有的那几行当基准，再统一其余部分，所以清完的样式跟你手写的一致。
why_en: It doesn't guess a house style — it reads the formatting already in your sheet as the baseline and normalizes the rest to match.
limit_zh: 只处理已经粘进工作表的区域，不连数据库、不读外部文件；空行和重复行按整行判断，部分重复的模糊匹配不管。
limit_en: Works only on a range already pasted into the sheet — no DB or file connections. Dedupes whole rows only, no fuzzy matching. Ambiguous dates like.
title_en: Turns messy pasted data into one clean, analysis-ready range
